subject: Q4 Shareholder Briefing: draft pack for stakeholder gate review
body:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Board Secretariat <board@redwood-inference.com>, Elena Park <elena@horizonvc.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Q4 Shareholder Briefing: draft pack for stakeholder gate review

Team — attaching the first full draft of the Q4 shareholder briefing (focused on QBR highlights, OKR progress, and near-term asks for investors). Goal is to run a quick stakeholder-gate review and lock slides that are investor-facing by end of week.

High-level asks:
- Jonas: numbers check (revenue, usage, runway impact of Dedicated deals)
- Lauren: OKR bullets and single-slide synthesis of cross-org asks
- Evelyn: narrative and risks section (competitor callouts, go-to-market notes)
- Marcus: visuals and appendix (chart labels and axis consistency)

Attachments: Q4_shareholder_brief_v1.pdf (slides), QBR_metrics_appendix.xlsx, stakeholder_comments_round1.docx

Timeline: please send final comments by Wed 10/14 10:00 PT. I will collate and push updated deck to drive before Thursday leadership readout.

Ben
Ben Carter
VP, Growth | Redwood Inference

---

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q4 Shareholder Briefing: draft pack for stakeholder gate review

Thanks Ben — skimmed and left inline notes in the appendix workbook. Two quick calls outs:
1) Revenue line in slide 6 includes a one-off partnership credit; I flagged it and suggested showing a pro-forma row.
2) Usage growth in August/September is stronger than modeled — recommend smoothing month-to-month but call out the spike and reason (large education partner onboarding).

I can rework the pro-forma table if helpful — happy to take it and post back by EOD.

—Jonas
Jonas Weber
Head of Finance | Redwood Inference

On Tue, 13 Oct 2026 at 09:42 AM Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks Ben and Jonas — I pulled the OKR slide into a one-pager (attached as a PDF in drive) and added status bullets for each priority.
>
> Two content asks:
> - Can we replace the product velocity metric with a shorter explanation of what we shipped (3 bullets) so investors see customer impact rather than engineering throughput?
> - For the "Risks" slide, I recommend a single-line mitigation for each risk so the tone is proactive.
>
> I'll consolidate wording and push to the drive link once Marcus confirms visuals.
>
> Lauren
> Director, Strategy & Ops
>
On Tue, 13 Oct 2026 at 10:05 AM Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com> wrote:
> Ben / team — looked through the slides; did a quick pass on fonts/legend treatment and fixed a few axis labels in the appendix.
>
> Note: slide 12 (market map) pulls an older version of the competitor logos; I updated to the 2026 banner and moved the legend to the bottom for readability.
>
> I'll push the updated assets to the drive and align on one master PNG for the print PDF by EOD.
>
> Marcus
> Senior Design Manager

---

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 16:54:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q4 Shareholder Briefing: draft pack for stakeholder gate review

All — I took a pass on the narrative and tightened the "asks" section to three clear investor asks (capacity commit, watchlist support for pilot partners, and follow-up customer intros). I also expanded the "risks" slide with brief mitigations as Lauren suggested.

I've attached a redlined copy (stakeholder_comments_round1.docx) and uploaded a new PDF (Q4_shareholder_brief_v1.1.pdf) to the drive. Main changes:
- Move the product wins into a single slide under "Customer Impact"
- Reframe the competitor note to focus on differentiation (OPS + cost controls)
- Add a short appendix note on data governance for enterprise deals (requested by legal earlier this month)

Can we have a quick sync tomorrow morning (Wed 10/14 at 8:30 PT) to walk the readout before I forward to the board secretariat? If that works, I'll prepare speaker notes.

Evelyn
EVP, Product & GTM

On Wed, 14 Oct 2026 at 08:10 AM Elena Park <elena@horizonvc.com> wrote:
> Hi Ben / Evelyn — thanks for sharing and for the clear asks. I reviewed the high-level deck and ok to proceed to board circulation once you have the final PDF. Two requests from our side: 1) please include a 1-page appendix explaining the Dedicated capacity economics (we want a line item for unit cost savings and expected uptake over the next two quarters), and 2) add a one-paragraph topline for investors at the front ("What this quarter delivered and why it matters").
>
> If you can include those by Thursday morning we'll incorporate into investor briefing packs on Friday.
>
> Elena
> Partner, Horizon Ventures

---

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Park <elena@horizonvc.com>, Tom Myers <tom@oakvc.com>, Board Secretariat <board@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q4 Shareholder Briefing: draft pack for stakeholder gate review

Perfect — thanks everyone for the fast turn.
Plan: Evelyn will finalize the narrative and frontpage paragraph this morning; Jonas will land the pro-forma and the Dedicated economics appendix; Marcus will publish the final PNGs; Lauren will finalize the OKR one-pager. I will consolidate into master PDF and share to the drive + board secretariat by 13:00 PT.

If anything slips, ping here and we'll escalate to leadership. Otherwise I'll circulate the board-ready PDF and a short readout note once consolidated.

Ben
VP, Growth | Redwood Inference

[attachments: Q4_shareholder_brief_v1.pdf; QBR_metrics_appendix.xlsx; stakeholder_comments_round1.docx]
